en: \[VSCode] Fixed the side bar's Web tab not listing cloud sessions started after the window loaded; a failed load now says "Remote server is not connected" instead of "No web sessions yet"
zh: \[VSCode] 修复侧边栏的 Web 标签页不列出窗口加载后启动的云端 session 的问题；加载失败时现在显示“Remote server is not connected”，而不是“No web sessions yet”
